run_image_demo: run the VLPart demo on input images with a config file and confidence threshold
run_video_demo: run the VLPart demo on a video file and save or display visualized output frames
run_webcam_demo: run the VLPart demo using a webcam as input and display results in an OpenCV window
build_vlpart_config: build a detectron2 config by merging a YAML file with VLPart settings and command-line overrides
test_video_codec: test whether a given OpenCV video codec and file extension is supported for writing
